dimensions.name: Color
dimensions.evidence: 31+ distinct color values across 5 parallel token systems (Token, LuxeColors, GlowTokens, GlowStoreTokens, shared/theme); 0 of 8 Target HEX implemented; Dark Mode violates brand rule 4.2

dimensions.name: Typography
dimensions.evidence: 4 font families declared (Didot, CormorantGaramond, Inter, JetBrainsMono) but AppTypography uses generic 'serif'/'sans'; Target requires Cormorant Garamond (Display) + Manrope (Functional) - neither declared in pubspec.yaml

dimensions.name: Spacing
dimensions.evidence: Spacing class (8 values, base-4) vs LuxeSpacing (5 values, base-3.5) - parallel incompatible systems; missing 40, 64, 80 from target scale

dimensions.name: Radius
dimensions.evidence: Radii class (10 values) well-designed; GlowStoreTokens duplicates 5 values; LuxeCard uses LuxeSpacing.md (10.5) vs Radii.card (16)

dimensions.name: Elevation
dimensions.evidence: AppShadow class well-structured (4 levels) but t.shadow uses black (0x0A000000) not warm; target requires 'Soft Warm Elevation' with warm tone

dimensions.name: Buttons
dimensions.evidence: 4+ button systems (ElevatedButtonTheme, LuxeButton, OutlinedButtonTheme, TextButtonTheme, inline); Primary uses Gold871 not RoseGold; Aura variant missing; radius inconsistent (30px vs 10.5px vs 12px)

dimensions.name: Inputs
dimensions.evidence: InputDecorationTheme uses Radii.lg (16px) correctly; but Login/Register use inline InputDecoration with hardcoded colors/borders; focus border uses brandPrimary (Gold871)

dimensions.name: Cards
dimensions.evidence: 3 systems: CardTheme (Radii.xxl=24px), LuxeCard (LuxeSpacing.md=10.5px), inline Containers; target ~16px (Radii.card)

dimensions.name: Navigation
dimensions.evidence: 3 BottomNav implementations (main.dart, home_screen.dart, store_screen drawer); 3 AppBar patterns (Theme, SliverAppBar parallax, simple AppBar); no unified component

dimensions.name: Iconography
dimensions.evidence: 200+ Material Icons usages; 0 custom SVG icons; 0 icon font; target requires monoline refined line iconography

dimensions.name: Logo
dimensions.evidence: GlowAppLogo component: single source, explicit asset, 3:1 ratio enforced, colorFilter support

dimensions.name: Photography
dimensions.evidence: Photography-first in AuraWelcome, Login, Register; but 2-3 candidate 'official model' photos mixed with generic/3D illustrations; no asset management system

dimensions.name: Model
dimensions.evidence: No official model tracking in code; aura_welcome_background.jpg and register_concierge_background.jpg are candidates; design_ideas_* are 3D illustrations not photography

dimensions.name: Aura
dimensions.evidence: AuraWelcomeScreen (photography-first, GlowGlassCard), ResultsScreen (_PassportColors isolated), deepGreen #1C2B26 as Teal approx; missing: halos, geometry, glow components, unified tokens

dimensions.name: Decorative Language
dimensions.evidence: Gradients in belleza_luxe_gradients, luxe_components, inline; stars/sparkles in auth screens; no classification (Brand Core/Accent/Noise) applied

dimensions.name: Responsive
dimensions.evidence: Breakpoints class exists (mobile=0, tablet=600, desktop=1024, wide=1440) but unused in layouts; StoreScreen has mobile/desktop split in checkout; Home/ProviderDetail not verified

dimensions.name: Accessibility
dimensions.evidence: Gold871 on Cream 2.1:1 (fail WCAG AA 4.5:1); Gold871 on White 3.2:1 (fail); focus states only on Inputs; touch targets 48x48 in Theme but LuxeButton doesn't enforce

dimensions.name: Design Tokens
dimensions.evidence: Token class comprehensive (colors, spacing, radii, shadows, typography, breakpoints, animation, elevation); but 4 parallel token systems fragment authority

dimensions.name: Component Architecture
dimensions.evidence: Good core (Token, AppTheme, GlowStoreTokens, GlowAppLogo, GlowGlassCard); but duplication: 2 Card systems, 4 Button systems, 3 Nav systems, 2 Spacing/Radius systems

critical_gaps: Target HEX palette (8 colors) not implemented in Token.light

architecture_findings.title: 3+ Parallel Token Systems
architecture_findings.description: Token, LuxeColors, GlowTokens, GlowStoreTokens, shared/theme.dart all define colors; 3 spacing systems, 2 radius systems
architecture_findings.evidence: 5 files define colors, 31+ distinct beige/gold values

architecture_findings.title: Legacy Theme in 40+ Screens
architecture_findings.description: shared/theme.dart (hardcoded colors) imported alongside modern Token in main.dart and used across provider_detail, booking, login, register, provider_dashboard, etc.
architecture_findings.evidence: main.dart imports both; 40+ screens reference AppTheme.* or LuxeColors.*

architecture_findings.title: Component Duplication
architecture_findings.description: 2 Card systems (CardTheme, LuxeCard), 4 Button systems (Elevated/Outlined/TextButtonTheme, LuxeButton, inline), 3 Nav systems
architecture_findings.evidence: LuxeCard vs CardTheme radii differ (10.5 vs 24); LuxeButton 3 variants vs Theme 3 types

architecture_findings.title: Hardcoded Values in Components
architecture_findings.description: LuxeSpacing (6.5/10.5/14/17/24) vs Spacing (4/8/12/16/20/24/32/48); LuxeButton padding/radius hardcoded
architecture_findings.evidence: LuxeButton uses 16/12 padding, 10.5px radius; Theme uses Spacing.xl/Spacing.md, Radii.round (30px)

architecture_findings.title: Typography Not Resolved in Tokens
architecture_findings.description: AppTypography uses 'serif'/'sans' generic; real mapping happens inline via fontFamily in TextStyle
architecture_findings.evidence: LuxeTypography.bodyMd uses CormorantGaramond size 15; AppTypography.bodyMedium uses 'sans' size 14
